blocks.text: Lafz “Biotechnology” ka matlab hai "biology par bani technology". Science ki zaban mein biotechnology yeh hai: jandaron (organisms), un ke biological processes (hayati amal) ya systems ko istemal kar ke aisi cheezein banana jo insaan ki zindagi aur mahol (environment) ko behtar karein. Is ka asal maqsad medicine (dawa aur ilaaj), zaraat (agriculture) aur industry ke mushkil masail hal karna hai. Biotechnology bohat bara shoba hai, lekin yeh chapter is ke sab se ahem hisse, yaani genetic engineering, ke baare mein hai.

blocks.title: For information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Purani (traditional) biotechnology hazaron saal se fermentation (khameer uthana) ki shakal mein istemal ho rahi hai, jaise roti (bread), paneer (cheese) aur beer banana. Jadeed (modern) biotechnology 20vin sadi mein shuru hui, jab DNA ki banawat (structure) maloom hui aur DNA par kaam karne ke naye molecular tareeqe bane.

Biotechnology aik bari "chhatri" (umbrella) jaisi istilah hai jis ke neeche bohat se kaam aate hain. Lekin jadeed biotechnology ka asal "engine" “Genetic Engineering” hai. Genetic engineering ka matlab hai kisi jandar ke DNA mein tabdeeli (alteration) karna taa ke us ki khasoosiyat (traits) ya salahiyat (capabilities) badal jaye. Is mein genes dalna (inserting), nikalna (deleting) ya badalna (modifying) shamil hai, aur kabhi kabhi aik species se doosri species mein genes muntaqil (transfer) karna bhi.

blocks.prompt: Genetic engineering roti banane jaisi purani biotechnology se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Purani biotechnology jandaron ko jaise woh hain waise hi istemal karti hai, maslan fermentation mein khameer (yeast). Genetic engineering jandar ke DNA ko seedha badalti hai: genes dal kar, nikal kar ya badal kar, aur kabhi doosri species se gene la kar.

items: Biotechnology: jandaron, un ke hayati amal ya systems se insaan aur mahol ke liye mufeed cheezein banana.
Purani biotechnology: fermentation (bread, cheese, beer); jadeed biotechnology DNA ki banawat maloom hone ke baad aayi.
Genetic engineering: DNA badal kar traits ya capabilities badalna (genes dalna, nikalna, badalna, ya species ke darmiyan muntaqil karna).
